# Predict from a cosinor model

Given a time variable and optional covariates, generate predicted values
from a cosinor fit. Default prediction is the mean value, optionally can
predict at a given month

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'cglmm'
predict(object, newdata, ...)
```

## Arguments

- object:

  An object of class `cglmm`.

- newdata:

  Optional new data.

- ...:

  other arguments passed to `glmmTMB:::predict.glmmTMB`.

## Value

Returns predicted values from the cosinor model.

## Examples

``` r

fit <- cglmm(vit_d ~ X + amp_acro(time,
  group = "X",
  n_components = 1,
  period = 12
), data = vitamind)
predict(fit)
```
